messages:
maria: Escalation from ACME — their canary rollout 'svc-auth@v2.1' has been stuck in 'In progress' for ~42m. Traffic never shifted. Console last health event 2026-03-10T14:02:01Z. Ticket https://support.redwood/acme/12345 :rotating_light:

alex: Can you paste the rollout_id and console link?

maria: rollout_id: rollout-abc123
console: https://console.redwood.company/rollouts/rollout-abc123

maria: Repro steps customer used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  https://console.api.redwood/rollouts/rollout-abc123/status
# returns:
{
  "state": "in_progress",
  "last_update": "2026-03-10T14:02:01Z"
}
```

alex: Events endpoint returns empty list?

maria: events -> []

samir: I can take this. Initial guess: status-sync worker backlog or message consumer stall. Can you grab last logs from status-sync? Run:
```
kubectl logs -n platform deploy/status-sync-0 --tail=200 | grep rollout-abc123
```

maria: Pasted logs (snip):
```
2026-03-10T14:03:10Z ERROR controller: failed to ack message: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-10T14:03:12Z WARN retry: requeued message rollout-abc123 attempt=12
2026-03-10T14:03:13Z ERROR consumer: failed to process event: connection reset by peer
```

samir: Looks like the consumer is timing out and requeuing. Checking queue metrics — Redis list length ~125k, DLQ growing. samir: Eng-SRE, any recent broker/network changes?

deploy-bot: Incident alert: status-sync consumer error rate spike 14:02 UTC :eyes:

samir: We saw a config tweak to message broker max_inflight yesterday which likely reduced throughput. Proposed plan: 1) scale status-sync +3 replicas; 2) drain messages older than 1h to DLQ (to avoid reprocessing very old events); 3) run backfill to reprocess the last 24h. Will validate in staging first.

alex: Note — console charts will remain stale until events are processed; suggest showing a short banner to affected customers.

dina: Please send a short customer update after step 1 so they know we're working on it.

samir: Starting staging restart now.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: status-sync scale to 4 replicas (staging)

deploy-bot: status-sync (staging) scaled successfully

samir: Staging restart cleared backlog and events started flowing — console updated for staging canary. Scheduling prod scale and controlled purge in 10m. Request SRE watch during prod changes.

samir: Proceeding with prod scale; will not delete messages <1h to avoid data loss.

deploy-bot: status-sync (prod) scaled to 4 replicas — successful

samir: Prod consumers catching up. Events stream now includes health updates for rollout-abc123. Confirmed console progress bar advancing.

maria: Customer notified: "We're seeing the canary progress update now; apologies for the noise, we're monitoring." :white_check_mark:

dina: Assigning postmortem to eng-infra to investigate the max_inflight change and add an alert for queue length >50k.

maria: Will close the support ticket once customer confirms stability.

alex: Adding a dashboard annotation for the incident window.

maria: Thanks all — nice quick ops. :clap:
